body.title: Sequence and component page builders
body.summary: In sequence.ts: autonumbered sequenceDiagram with real message labels, dashed returns, recursion and truncation notes, plus participants and ordered messages tables. In component.ts: flowchart LR with one box per component and labelled dependency arrows, plus a components table (component, path, depends on, description).
acceptanceChecks: Sequence source contains autonumber, every message label, -->> for returns, and the recursion/truncation notes.
Messages table is in call order with call/return/recurse tags.
Components table lists path, depends-on and description (null when absent).

tests.name: sequence page builder: autonumber, labels, dashed returns, notes; participants + messages tables (Delivery-board fixture)
component page builder: flowchart + components table
